text:
Aisha: Heads-up: GOV customer wants a prep pack for next week's FedRAMP readiness call. They asked: RBAC change log since last review, immutable audit export with signed checksum and retention proof, KMS envelope flow for private deployments, FIPS-certified HSM options (timeline), vuln triage summary, and IR playbook excerpt. Who can own what?

Carlos: I can produce RBAC change log (csv) and short memo about role separation controls. Will redact emails and replace with hashed IDs.

Dana: I'll run an immutable audit export and produce the manifest + signature. Plan: export -> compute SHA256 -> sign with our key -> include export job runlog as evidence.

Aisha: Also need a note about how we prevent export tampering (object ACLs, signed manifests, bucket immutability). Include retention lifecycle policy screenshots if available.

Carlos: Noted. I'll include lifecycle screenshot and the legal-hold extension process.

sre-oncall: Example query for sanitized log samples: `resource.type="redwood_server" AND protoPayload.methodName="UpdateRole"`. Retention set via lifecycle: 400 days for audit_events; immutable holds can extend.

Dana: Upload plan: temp export to `s3://secproofs/gov/5644440000/export.tar.gz`, manifest `export-5644440000.json`, signature `export-5644440000.sig`. I'll paste the signed manifest link when done.

Aisha: KMS envelope and HSM FIPS question: do we have a current FIPS-HSM vendor option for private? If not, customer wants roadmap and mitigations.

sec-eng-bot: Current status: no in-place FIPS-certified HSM in private deploys. Vendors evaluated: VaultHSM (FIPS-validated module planned Q4), IronKeyHSM (awaiting integration). Recommend compensating control: strict KMS key rotation, usage audit, and attestations.

Carlos: I'll draft a short FAQ: "No current FIPS HSM, roadmap Q4, mitigations in place".

Dana: Export finished. Uploaded to `s3://secproofs/gov/5644440000/export.tar.gz`. Manifest SHA256: `9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015`. Signature uploaded as `export-5644440000.sig`.

Aisha: Great. We also need vuln triage summary: recent high/critical findings, patch windows, and time-to-remediation SLA.

Carlos: Will compile triage timeline for last 6 months and current open items. Will scrub ticket IDs that are internal-only.

sre-oncall: For IR playbook excerpt, I can provide the 1-page runbook (containment -> forensics -> notification) and the escalation matrix.

Aisha: Need two reviewers before external share. Please tag when uploads done. Compliance will sign off.

Dana: Uploaded artifacts and requested review in `s3://secproofs/gov/5644440000/`.

Carlos: Uploaded RBAC CSV `rbac_delta_5644440000.csv` (hashed IDs) and lifecycle screenshots. Added redaction notes.

sec-eng-bot: Reminder: checklist requires artifacts index, 2 reviewers, and compliance approval recorded.

Aisha: I'll review the manifest and RBAC CSV. Dana, Carlos 9-- can you get a second reviewer?

sre-oncall: I'll review the IR excerpt and the log samples. LGTM on IR.

Aisha: LGTM from me on manifest and KMS FAQ. Two reviewers done.

compliance-bot: External share allowed pending final stamp. Audit trail recorded for artifact uploads.

Aisha: I'll assemble the FedRAMP prep PDF and upload to the secure share. Please keep follow-ups in this thread. Thanks.

Carlos: One follow-up for the call: customer asked about SIEM integration latency for exported logs. I'll add a small note on export delivery times and buffering.

Dana: Adding export job run timestamps to the manifest for provenance.

Aisha: Closing prep thread. Reopen if compliance requests more info.
